title: Arqit Quantum Inc. Reports Select Preliminary FY 2026 Financial Results: Annual Revenue Tops $975K, NATO Contract Win, and Cash Position Reaches $51M - Quantum Computing Report
gist: Arqit Quantum expects FY2026 revenue of $975K-$1.0M, up about 84-89% from $530K, with cash of about $51M and a new NATO consortium contract, but H2 revenue fell after a Middle East customer stopped paying due to geopolitical disruption.

insights.claim: Arqit expects FY2026 (ended Sep 30, 2026) revenue of $975,000 to $1,000,000, roughly 84% to 89% above $530,000 in FY2025, supported by prior contracts and seven new commercial contracts.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Growth is from a very small base; revenue scale remains minimal.
insights.locator: Financial Highlights & Full Fiscal Year Growth

insights.claim: Arqit's H2 FY2026 revenue is expected at $355,000-$380,000, down from $623,000 in H1 FY2026 and $463,000 in H2 FY2025, hurt by the end of revenue from a material Middle East customer contract due to geopolitical disruptions.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Customer concentration and geopolitical exposure create revenue volatility.

insights.claim: Arqit held about $51.0M in cash at Sep 30, 2026, up from $28.9M at March 31, 2026 and $36.9M at Sep 30, 2025.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Cash rose despite tiny revenue, implying external financing; runway looks comfortable versus operating scale.

insights.claim: On Oct 6, 2026 Arqit signed as part of a winning consortium to supply quantum-safe secure networking services to NATO, with a one-year base period and two annual renewal options.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Marquee defense customer, though contract value is not disclosed.

insights.claim: Arqit signed three contracts for its Encryption Intelligence automated cryptographic discovery and inventory tool in H2 FY2026, with revenue starting late H2 or Q1 FY2027.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Early PQC-migration discovery tooling demand; revenue contribution will show in FY2027.

insights.claim: Arqit renewed or upsized two enterprise contracts and expanded channel partnerships with Tomorrow Street, Intel and European cybersecurity integrators for PQC migration planning.
insights.speaker: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
insights.so_what: Channel partnerships may be the route to scaling PQC sales.
